136: theorem height_bound_of_component_bounds {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps) (CH : ℝ) (Eb Ec CF0 : List ℝ → ℝ)
137:     (hL : Fm.Large (thrHH Eb Ec CF0) CH)
138:     (h4 : Formalism.MainNotions.LocalQuadraticParts.SlopeLemmaFamily Fm) (hrk : Formalism.MainNotions.J.MuRank Fm)
139:     (hfull : ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, ∀ i : Fm.Ix x, (Fm.D x i).NuFull)
140:     (hb : ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, Fm.x1 < x → ∀ (i : Fm.Ix x) u,
141:       (((Fm.D x i).fm u).lat 0).muMax ≤ (Fm.L x i).sc.x ^ Eb Fm.cOut * (Fm.L x i).sc.b)
142:     (hc : ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, Fm.x1 < x → ∀ (i : Fm.Ix x) u,
143:       (Fm.L x i).Ga + (Fm.L x i).Fo - (Fm.L x i).Ee u ≤ (Fm.L x i).sc.x ^ Ec Fm.cOut * (Fm.L x i).sc.b)
144:     (hTu : TuSize Fm)
145:     (he : ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, ∀ (_ : Fm.x1 < x) (i : Fm.Ix x),
146:       (Fm.D x i).div.RR.muMax + meanE (Fm.D x i) (fun e => Real.log ((Fm.X x i).kapR e)) ≤
147:         (Fm.L x i).sc.x ^ CF0 Fm.cOut * (Fm.L x i).sc.b) :
148:     Formalism.MainNotions.LocalQuadraticParts.FrameNumberBoundFamily Fm Fm.Csz CH :=
149:   height_bound_of_slope_fullness Fm CH h4 hrk hfull
150:     (hhRest_of_parts Fm CH Eb Ec CF0 (hL.2.2.1 CH List.mem_cons_self) hb hc hTu he)

21: inductive GeoCl (Γ : GeoP) : ∀ D : D7, Formalism.L2.Pj.Core D → DivX D → Prop
22:   | base {D : D7} {J : Formalism.L2.Pj.Core D} {X : DivX D} : Γ D J X → GeoCl Γ D J X
23:   | step {D : D7} (N : ∀ u, Submodule (𝓞 D.what₂.LL) (D.div.Nu u).V) (h : D.what₂.Word → ℝ)
24:       {J : Formalism.L2.Pj.Core D} {X : DivX D} : GeoCl Γ D J X → GeoCl Γ (setDiv D N h) (coreS N h J) (divTr N h X)

26: def geoCl (Γ : GeoP) : GeoP := GeoCl Γ
